description: Document important care decisions and reasoning.
notes: Coded against the Kit contract with a guarded inline fallback shim (window.Kit || ...); the real shared/kit.js landed mid-build and takes precedence — all 10 verified against the real kit: zero console/page errors, core interactions clicked, 1280x800 shot captured.

notes.note: Writing down the reasoning behind painful family decisions is humane and wise, and almost nobody will pay $6/mo for it. It's used at life's worst moments, a few times ever — that's a grief tool, not a subscription. The advisor-collaboration seat is the only revenue-shaped idea here, and it's thin.
All 3 tabs (weigh/deciders/discussion) work; copy summary OK, zero errors.

notes.change: Per-decider sign-off on the locked decision: signed tally in the status line, signed badges, log entries, and signed flags in the copied summary.
